comment: Ordered rebrand rules applied by rebrand.mjs to every tracked text file of a pristine DataDog/rum-events-format tree. Order matters: more specific rules must precede rules that match a substring of them. 'literal' rules are plain string replacement; 'regex' rules are applied with the 'g' flag. Surgical by design: only the RUM event internal namespace (_dd -> _o2), the tracing-propagator enum, and repository/description identity are changed. Fork-owned identity files (LICENSE, NOTICE, README, .github) are handled by the keep-ours overlay, not here. Cosmetic 'Datadog' mentions in schema descriptions are intentionally left alone. lib/generated/** is NOT rebranded here: it is regenerated from the rebranded schemas by `yarn generate`.

rules.literal: JSON schema of Datadog RUM events
rules.to: JSON schema of OpenObserve RUM events

rules.why: add 'openobserve' as a selectable tracing propagator so telemetry configuration events emitted by the OpenObserve SDK validate

RUM/telemetry event internal namespace field renamed _dd -> _o2 across all schemas and samples (user-visible in captured event data, e.g. event._o2.trace_id). Word-boundary regex; upstream schemas only use the exact token "_dd". Must match browser-sdk's rename-map.json rule for the same token.
